description:
Sobre a Soul Malls

Somos uma empresa com atuação em planejamento, gestão, desenvolvimento e comercialização de empreendimentos comerciais em diversos estados do Brasil. Acreditamos que nossos empreendimentos possuem alma, vocação e que os melhores resultados são fruto da gestão que valoriza as potencialidades e diferenciais de cada um. Reunimos em nosso portfólio dezenas de shoppings centers, greenfields, expansões e outros conceitos como centros gastronômicos, liderados por um time de excelência que reúne conhecimento, energia e paixão pelo que faz, agindo como dono, de forma próxima e comprometida com o dia-a-dia do negócio. Buscamos a maximização dos resultados sustentáveis de longo prazo, por meio de uma gestão eficiente e profissional, processos estruturados e sensibilidade mercadológica.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Coordenador(a) de Administração de Pessoal, na Soul Malls, você irá:

  • Efetuar os cálculos dos encargos trabalhistas e confecção das guias de recolhimento, visando o cumprimento dos prazos e determinações legais (IRRF, INSS, FGTS);
  • Efetuar os cálculos dos pagamentos relativos a férias e rescisões de contratos de trabalho, visando o seu correto pagamento e cumprimento dos prazos legais;
  • Preparar relatórios de DIRF, RAIS, Informe de Rendimentos, CAGED e outras obrigações acessórias relacionadas com a folha de pagamento;
  • Emitir relação para crédito em conta corrente bancária dos colaboradores;
  • Efetuar reajustes salariais de acordo com dissídios de classe;
  • Acompanhar e aplicar as convenções e acordos de sindicatos;
  • Atender a fiscalização trabalhista e previdenciária, fornecendo as informações e documentos solicitados;
  • Emitir relatórios mensais com dados da folha de pagamento para efeito de contabilização e controle de custos;
  • Garantir o arquivamento digital do dossiê de todos os colaboradores da empresa;
  • Manter controles de todos os valores a serem descontados em folha de pagamento visando a correta quitação de débitos;
  • Participar da definição da estratégia de benefícios da empresa com base nas necessidades internas e melhores práticas do mercado;
  • Consolidar e apresentar para a gestão os indicadores da área;
  • Monitorar os processos da área, buscando melhorias e automatizações;
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com a natureza da função.

  • Superior completo em Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou afins.

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

title: Compliance Counsel
description:
Zimmer Biomet Rio de Janeiro Candidatar-se At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

The Associate Director & Counsel, Global Compliance Investigations, will be responsible for conducting confidential internal investigations on behalf of Zimmer Biomet. This position will report to the Director & Senior Counsel - Americas, Global Compliance Investigations (“GCI”), and will be responsible for investigations in the Latin America (LatAm) region. He/she will work closely and collaboratively with legal and compliance team members in the global and LatAm regional offices, manage outside counsel, as well as external investigation-related vendors and consultants.

How You'll Create Impact

Global Compliance Investigations

  • Evaluate and manage hotline and non-hotline complaints and other potential compliance issues, including assessing the matter upfront, triaging matters to the appropriate team member or function, and developing work plans for items handled by the global compliance investigations team.
  • Leverage other investigation resources as needed, as well as developing findings and memorializing these efforts and final conclusions.
  • Engage and oversee outside counsel, including regular contact with outside counsel, auditors, consultants and vendors.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to prepare and present findings of all investigations to relevant disciplinary committees and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to provide regular updates on investigations and findings to the Vice President, Global Compliance Investigations, Chief Compliance Officer, General Counsel, and other senior leadership as appropriate.

Other

  • Actively monitor developments related to compliance, anticorruption enforcement, and other compliance-related matters, discussing with team members and drafting summaries/updates for external stakeholders.
  • Analyze investigative trends and update relevant stakeholders in the region.
  • Remain up-to-date on relevant trends and activities in the global compliance sphere within the life sciences industry.

What Makes You Stand Out

Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills and abilities)

  • Experience conducting and/or participating in investigation interviews or depositions.
  • Detail oriented, with a high degree of ethics, integrity, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Strong writing, editing and analytical skills, including a command of grammar and style conventions.
  • Experience drafting investigation-related documents, including interview memoranda, document review protocols, investigation reports and presentations.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Highly motivated, self‑starter willing to meet strict deadlines and time constraints.
  • Strong leadership presence and ability to manage people and projects effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and work as part of a team, able to build relationships across and outside the department.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to a diverse audience at multiple levels within the company through various formats.
  • Excellent note‑taking skills.
  • Familiarity with forensic accounting, US GAAP, and payment systems (such as SAP) a plus.
  • Must be fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese language skills a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Your Background

Education/Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience, with a strong preference for experience with compliance and conducting internal investigations, including FCPA‑related investigations, ideally for multinational companies in the health care/life sciences industry.
  • Experience with investigations in the Latin America region highly preferred.

Travel Expectations

Travel Requirements

  • International travel required on an as needed basis.

title: Amxl Operations
description:
DESCRIPTION

Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It is essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and quality. It acts both tactically, analyzing metrics, and operationally, following the daily routine and resolving deviations on the ground. It works in collaboration with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. It is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, ensuring the best customer experience.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
  • English Skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with SQL

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$20.11 per hour

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is a senior‑level executive responsible for establishing and maintaining the enterprise vision, strategy, and program to ensure information assets and technologies are adequately protected. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and/or Board of Directors and is critical in managing the information security risk across both the Academic/Research and Clinical/Patient Care domains of the combined institution.

Supervisory Authority

The CISO holds overarching responsibility for the institution’s information security framework. The CISO directly supervises the information security team, including managers, analysts, and technical specialists, and provides guidance to IT and operational departments on security matters. The CISO has the authority to make decisions regarding policies, procedures, and resource allocation within the information security program. This role also collaborates with other department heads and external partners to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

Nature And Scope

The CISO operates at the executive level, reporting to the CEO and/or the Board of Directors. The scope of this position covers both Academic/Research and Clinical/Patient Care domains, ensuring that the institution’s information assets and technologies are adequately protected. The CISO is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining a comprehensive information security strategy that aligns with the organization’s overall mission and goals. This includes risk assessment, policy development, security awareness training, incident response, and compliance management. The CISO works closely with senior leadership, legal, compliance, and technology teams to manage security risk and respond effectively to threats in a complex and dynamic environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Strategy and Leadership

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive, long‑term information security strategy and roadmap aligned with the business goals, academic mission, and patient care objectives of both the university and hospital.
  • Lead the security organization, providing mentorship, guidance, and training to security staff and cross‑functional teams.
  • Establish security governance frameworks, policies, and standards to ensure effective risk management and compliance.
  • Manage the information security budget and procurement of necessary security technologies and services.

Risk Management and Compliance

  • Oversee all security risk assessments and audits, ensuring timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and standards, including but not limited to:
    • Healthcare (Hospital Focus): HIPAA/HITECH (Privacy and Security Rules), CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) requirements, and relevant state‑specific healthcare data regulations.
    • Higher Education/Research (University Focus): FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act), NIST SP 800‑171 (for controlled unclassified information/research), and PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) for handling student payments and donations.
  • Manage the incident response program, including planning, testing, and leading the response to significant security breaches or incidents across both institutional environments.

Operational Security

  • Direct the selection, implementation, and maintenance of security systems and tools (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, etc.).
  • Oversee the vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security monitoring programs.
  • Collaborate with IT and Engineering teams to integrate security by design into all new systems, research projects, and clinical technologies.

Communication and Training

  • Serve as the primary spokesperson for information security matters to senior leadership, the Board, faculty, staff, students, and patients.
  • Develop and manage institution‑wide security awareness and training programs tailored to the unique risks and requirements of clinicians, researchers, and students.
  • Report on the security posture and significant risk exposures to executive management and the Board of Directors on a regular basis.

Core Competencies

  • Expert Knowledge of enterprise security architecture, network security, cloud security, and risk assessment methodologies.
  • In‑depth understanding of security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of a complex organization (clinical, academic, administrative).
  • Proven ability to manage crises and lead an effective security incident response team.
  • A strong record of implementing pragmatic and effective security solutions in environments with competing priorities (e.g., open research vs. strict patient data protection).

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in information security, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., CISO, VP of Security).
  • Dual‑Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated experience or deep understanding of the regulatory and security challenges in both the healthcare and higher education/research sectors is mandatory.

Certifications (One Or More Required)

  • CISSP, CISM, or similar relevant certifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $230,000 - $250,000

Elle s'appuie sur des équipes locales implantées directement dans les destinations afin d'offrir une expertise terrain fine, des expériences personnalisées et un accompagnement de proximité. Son modèle repose sur un tourisme responsable, privilégiant les rencontres, la découverte culturelle, la nature et les expériences hors des sentiers battus. Elle accompagne une clientèle francophone exigeante, en quête de voyages uniques, qu'il s'agisse de séjours individuels, de voyages de noces, d'aventures en famille ou de circuits thématiques. Entreprise en croissance, à taille humaine, elle combine une forte culture du service, une approche digitale performante et un esprit entrepreneurial, avec des équipes réparties entre la France et plusieurs pays d'implantation.

Job Description

VOTRE MISSION

Le General Manager H/F est responsable du pilotage global de sa Business Unit. Il/Elle garantit la performance commerciale, opérationnelle et financière, le management des équipes locales et la bonne exécution de la stratégie du groupe. Il incarne la vision du groupe et veille au respect des standards de qualité, des valeurs et de la culture de l'entreprise. La maîtrise du français et du portugais est obligatoire pour postuler.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

ADMINISTRATION & LÉGAL

  • Interface avec les partenaires institutionnels et juridiques locaux
  • Suivi de la conformité réglementaire et respect des obligations locales (tourisme, social, fiscal)

  • Renforcement de la notoriété et du positionnement de Tierra Latina sur les marchés cibles

MANAGEMENT

  • Recrutement, intégration et montée en compétence des équipes Sales & Ops
  • Animation des équipes : réunions hebdomadaires et one-to-one mensuels et annuels
  • Pilotage de la performance individuelle et collective (objectifs & KPIs)
  • Gestion des congés, absences, bien-être et climat social
  • Application et déploiement des process et décisions stratégiques du groupe
  • Développement d'une culture d'entreprise forte, axée sur la cohésion et l'excellence du service

VENTES & DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL

  • Définition des objectifs annuels et mensuels par destination
  • Suivi des ventes, des marges et mise en place d'actions correctives
  • Supervision des devis et validation des cotations complexes
  • Support aux Sales Managers lors de négociations clés et partenariats stratégiques
  • Amélioration continue de la qualité des voyages et de l'expérience client

OPÉRATIONNEL

  • Supervision des opérations et du bon déroulement des voyages
  • Gestion des situations critiques et litiges 24/7
  • Coordination des paiements prestataires avec les équipes Ops
  • Arbitrage entre qualité, délais et coûts
  • Optimisation continue des process opérationnels en lien avec la Finance

FINANCE & REPORTING

  • Élaboration et suivi des budgets annuels
  • Suivi mensuel du chiffre d'affaires, des marges et de la rentabilité
  • Pilotage du cash-flow et suivi des encaissements clients
  • Supervision des paiements fournisseurs et priorisation de trésorerie
  • Contrôle des coûts (buying price vs coût final) et sécurisation des marges
  • Reporting régulier à la Direction / CFO et contribution aux décisions stratégiques
  • Suivi des pièces comptables et coordination avec cabinets comptables locaux

PRODUCTION

  • Supervision de la création de nouveaux produits, itinéraires et expériences
  • Gestion et animation des relations fournisseurs
  • Développement de nouveaux partenariats locaux
  • Veille et benchmark régulier pour assurer compétitivité et différenciation des offres

RSE & TOURISME DURABLE

  • Garant de la stratégie RSE de la BU, en cohérence avec la vision du groupe
  • Pilotage du maintien et renouvellement de la certification Travelife
  • Sensibilisation et mobilisation des équipes sur les enjeux RSE
  • Suivi et reporting des KPIs RSE (procédures, conformité, actions mises en place)

VOS INDICATEURS DE PERFORMANCE (KPIs)

Critères quantitatifs

  • Taux de rotation des membres de l'équipe : max 20% / an
  • Taux de marge par dossier (POF réalisés et réservés vs objectifs annuels)
  • Suivi et maîtrise des coûts indirects (MIS) : réalisés vs budget annuel
  • Taux de satisfaction client global : ≥ 9/10
  • Taux de satisfaction des équipes (enquêtes internes)

Critères qualitatifs

  • Leadership & management : capacité à fédérer, structurer et développer les équipes dans une culture de performance et d'excellence.
  • Vision stratégique et pilotage : capacité à définir, communiquer et déployer une stratégie claire alignée avec les objectifs du groupe.
  • Excellence opérationnelle & discipline financière : capacité à garantir une exécution fluide, maîtriser les coûts et sécuriser les marges.
  • Représentation & valeurs (incluant RSE) : capacité à représenter le groupe avec crédibilité et à incarner la culture et les engagements du groupe.

Profile / Requirements

  • Vous maîtrisez impérativement le français, le portugais et l'anglais.
  • Issu(e) d'une expérience dans le secteur du voyage, du tourisme ou de l'hôtellerie,
  • avec une expérience confirmée en gestion d'équipe, développement commercial, gestion financière et pilotage opérationnel d'au moins 2 ans.
  • Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des enjeux économiques, logistiques et réglementaires du secteur, de préférence dans un contexte international.
  • Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication, négociation, management et prise de décision.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques.
  • Vous faites preuve d'un leadership solide et savez fédérer et motiver des équipes multiculturelles.
  • Vous alliez vision stratégique et efficacité opérationnelle, avec rigueur, autonomie, sens des responsabilités et une forte orientation résultats.
  • Adaptable et mature professionnellement, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement international et dynamique, avec un réel sens du service, un esprit entrepreneurial et un goût prononcé pour l'innovation.

Benefits

CONDITIONS SALARIALES

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

Role

Canonical is looking for a creative and data-driven Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline for our products. This role blends strategy with hands‑on execution, from crafting compelling campaigns and driving demand generation, to collaborating cross‑functionally with Sales, SDRs, Product, Communications, and Alliances.

As a key contributor to our marketing team, you'll take ownership of high‑impact programs including integrated campaigns, product launches, events, and account‑based marketing. You'll play a pivotal role in connecting our products with the right audiences whether enterprise customers, developers, or strategic partners.

You thrive in fast‑paced environments, love experimenting and optimizing based on data. You are passionate about technology, marketing and the use of technology in marketing. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to make things better for your campaigns, your team, and your own growth. If you enjoy building smart, scalable marketing engines with a bit of creative flair, we'd love to hear from you.

Location

Remote, EMEA

What your day will look like

  • Own end‑to‑end go‑to‑market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data‑driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data‑driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands‑on execution, a true self‑starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Descrição

Você está em busca de um desafio no setor offshore? O Enfermeiro Marítimo (ENF) será responsável por prestar cuidados de saúde e promover o bem-estar da tripulação nas embarcações. Local da vaga: Offshore.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Suporta todos os aspectos do Sistema de Gestão de Segurança nas operações do dia-a-dia;
  • Manter a farmácia, enfermaria e isolamento em perfeitas condições, ordem, limpeza e higiene;
  • Comunicar, por escrito, ao Comandante, através do Imediato, sempre que um tripulante tenha estado internado na enfermaria de bordo, bem como a existência de pessoa acometida de doença infecciosa ou sujeita a notificação obrigatória, providenciando, nestes casos, as providências necessárias prevenir a propagação da doença;
  • Siga rigorosamente as instruções do Departamento Nacional de Saúde ou outra autoridade governamental;
  • Examinar diariamente, os géneros provenientes dos armazéns e câmaras frigoríficas de bordo, para preparação dos alimentos;
  • Acompanhar, obrigatoriamente, a entrada do material alimentar a bordo, a fim de verificar a sua qualidade, comunicando ao Comandante, através do Imediato, quaisquer irregularidades, incluindo o estado dos locais onde se encontram armazenados os alimentos;
  • Fiscalizar o embarque dos tripulantes e a sua entrada a bordo, não permitindo o embarque de todos os que sejam portadores de doença infecciosa ou outra, que pela sua natureza não possam ser tratados a bordo;
  • Acompanhar o Comandante durante a inspeção de saúde em todas as instalações a bordo;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre o estado de saúde dos tripulantes e dos impossibilitados de permanecer a bordo, comunicando ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato;
  • Atender, a qualquer tempo, os acidentes ocorridos a bordo, prestando os socorros necessários à vítima e, como Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho Offshore, classificar as lesões;
  • Comparecer à visita das autoridades sanitárias, em portos nacionais e estrangeiros;
  • Prestar informações ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato, sobre as condições sanitárias a bordo;
  • Acompanhar serviços de controle de pragas (todos os tipos), fumigação, desinfecção e descontaminação a bordo;
  • Permanecer em posto médico a bordo durante o horário previamente estabelecido pelo Comandante;
  • Manter devidamente inventariado todo o material de saúde (equipamentos cirúrgicos, medicamentos e utensílios de farmácia), material de primeiros socorros, zelando pela sua conservação e contabilizando as faltas encontradas;
  • Solicitar medicamentos e materiais necessários, encaminhando-os ao Comandante, por meio do Imediato;
  • Apresentar lista do material de saúde que houver a bordo, que deverá ser entregue às autoridades de cada porto;
  • Apoiar o Mestre, o Médico do Trabalho e a Enfermeira do Trabalho Onshore tudo o que for necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, com registro ativo no COREN;
  • CIR Válida;
  • TBS-1 e EBCP Válidos;
  • Experiência comprovada no segmento marítimo;
  • Vivência em atendimento de urgência e emergência.

title: Analista de Remuneração SR
description:
Atuar como referência técnica em Remuneração na Log-In, liderando análises, modelos e projetos de remuneração fixa e variável, suportando decisões estratégicas da Diretoria e de Gente & Gestão. Garantir estruturas salariais competitivas, políticas claras e sustentáveis, equilíbrio interno/externo e aderência a orçamento, contribuindo para atração, retenção e engajamento dos talentos da Companhia, em alinhamento à estratégia do negócio, valores corporativos e Sistema de Gestão Integrada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A SUA ROTINA INCLUI:

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários

    Atuar como guardião da política de cargos e salários, apoiando revisões, melhorias e desdobramentos junto às áreas de negócio. Conduzir análises de equilíbrio interno (faixas, sobreposições, compressão salarial, enquadramentos) e propor ajustes em estruturas, níveis e grades. Apoiar e/ou liderar processos de descrição, avaliação e classificação de cargos, utilizando metodologias corporativas (pontos, fatores, famílias, trilhas de carreira etc.). Atualizar e manter tabelas salariais, referências, amplitudes e ranges por unidade de negócio, nível e função, garantindo coerência com a estrutura organizacional.

  • Pesquisas de Mercado e Competitividade Externa

    Coordenar a participação da Log-In em pesquisas salariais de mercado (empresas de consultoria, sindicatos e entidades setoriais), garantindo qualidade das informações enviadas. Analisar resultados de pesquisas (ex.: P50, P25, P75) e elaborar estudos comparativos de competitividade por cargo, família, unidade de negócio e região. Elaborar recomendações técnicas de posicionamento salarial, ajustes de faixa, política para novos cargos e estratégias para funções críticas e de difícil reposição.

  • Ciclos de Mérito, Ajustes Gerais e Recomposição

    Planejar, modelar e simular cenários de mérito, promoções, ajustes de faixas e recomposição por Acordo Coletivo, considerando budget, diretrizes de Diretoria e impacto em folha. Desenvolver ferramentas (planilhas, modelos, painéis) que suportem alocação de verba de mérito pelas lideranças, garantindo simplicidade e governança. Apoiar Gente & Gestão e a Diretoria na definição de diretrizes anuais (critérios de elegibilidade, limites, prazos e mensagens-chave) para os ciclos de revisão salarial. Acompanhar a execução dos processos no sistema (ERP, HCM etc.), tratando exceções, conferindo resultados e assegurando integridade de dados.

  • Programas de Remuneração Variável e Incentivos

    Apoiar a modelagem, revisão e governança de programas de remuneração variável (bônus/PLR, incentivos de curto prazo, comissões, gratificações), alinhados à estratégia e resultados do negócio. Desenvolver e analisar indicadores, metas e pesos dos programas de incentivo em parceria com Finanças, áreas de negócio e Gente & Gestão. Elaborar simulações de cenários de pagamento, impacto financeiro e comparativos históricos, apoiando decisões da Diretoria e do Conselho, quando aplicável.

  • Análises, Estudos Especiais e Governança

    Produzir dashboards, relatórios e análises de remuneração (pay mix, pay gap, estrutura por nível, dispersão, headcount e payroll) para Diretoria, Comitês e Conselhos, quando demandado. Apoiar estudos de reorganização organizacional (fusões de áreas, criação/extinção de cargos, movimentações em massa), avaliando impactos em remuneração e propondo soluções técnicas. Atuar como referência para consultas complexas de remuneração das áreas (pacotes de contratação, retenção, realocação, casos críticos e exceções), garantindo aderência às políticas e governança. Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas à equidade interna, diversidade e inclusão do ponto de vista de remuneração (estudos de pay equity, recortes por gênero, raça, unidade etc.).

  • Processos, Sistemas e Melhoria Contínua

    Propor e liderar melhorias em processos, políticas, ferramentas e sistemas de remuneração, buscando mais automação, segurança e padronização. Atuar em conjunto com TI, Finanças e Gente & Gestão na evolução de sistemas de folha, HCM, analytics e workflow relacionados a cargos, salários e incentivos. Contribuir para a documentação e atualização de normas, políticas, manuais e comunicados de remuneração, garantindo entendimento por parte de líderes e colaboradores. Conhecer a política, objetivos e metas do Sistema de Gestão Integrada. Cumprir os procedimentos aplicáveis à atividade desenvolvida e os programas de qualidade, meio ambiente, saúde e segurança implementados na Companhia. Conhecer os aspectos e impactos significativos associados às práticas de remuneração e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dentro do seu escopo.

title: Academic Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The UBMS Program Coordinator fosters a learning environment that encompasses academic achievement and college preparation that centers around STEM related fields. The coordinator promotes the vision and skill level for successful graduation at the secondary level and success with college matriculation and post-secondary completion.

Supervisory Authority

The Program Coordinator will supervise approximately 3-12 wage employees to include tutors, teachers, and counselors.

Nature And Scope

The Program Coordinator is responsible for facilitating the planning, implementation, and evaluation of the various components of the Upward Bound Mathematics and Science (UBMS) program which falls under the TRIO Programs with the Department of Education. The UBMS program is designed to strengthen the math and science skills of participating students. The goal of the program is to help students recognize and develop their potential to excel in science, technology and mathematics to encourage them to pursue postsecondary degrees in STEM disciplines. The Upward Bound Math and Science program at Howard University serves 52 students from selected schools in DC and Prince George’s County in grades 9 through 12. TRIO Programs are located within the School of Education and the Program Coordinator for Upward Bound Mathematics and Science reports directly to the Director of the UBMS Program. This is a grant position that is fully funded until August 31,2027. The grant can be renewed for 5-year intervals at the conclusion of the current grant period.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinating with target high school staff in Washington, DC and Prince George’s County to continually recruit and retain 52 program participants each year.
  • Assist in the identification, recruitment and selection of project participants.
  • Planning, coordinating, and implementing the program's services, including Saturday Academy sessions during the academic year and 6-week summer program for each cohort.
  • These services include: academic instruction and tutoring, SAT & ACT preparation, career exploration, financial literacy education, cultural enrichment, community service, assistance completing college admissions and financial aid applications, and on-campus residential programs.
  • Maintaining documentation of services in electronic database and participant files.
  • Assisting in the hiring, training, supervision, and evaluation of summer instructors, tutors and summer residential staff as well as student volunteers.
  • Engaging with other UBMS staff members to provide formative assessment and continuous improvement of program delivery.
  • Assisting Program Director with preparation and submission of evaluations and reports, including the Department of Education Annual Performance Report
  • Developing and nurturing partnerships with faculty and staff of Howard University and DCPS and PGCPS School districts to enhance the program's services.
  • Coordinate and supervise the monthly Saturday Academic Sessions and Summer Component activities.
  • Coordinate and supervise college counseling sessions throughout the academic year.
  • Track senior participants' college and scholarship applications submissions and provide assistance where needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge and understanding of student development
  • Commitment to student growth
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to be creative and initiate positive impact
  • Ability to work individually and as a team member
  • Strong time management skills
  • Vibrant and Innovative

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, science, engineering, psychology, education, school counseling or another related field. Experience working with underserved youth population (ages 13-21). Strong classroom management skills

Some evening and weekend hours required during the academic year, and extended hours during the summer component.

Preferred Requirements

  • Master’s degree in education, social work, counseling or related fields
  • Knowledge of student development
  • Prior TRIO experience
  • Ability to effectively design math and science curriculum
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and conduct intensive science enrichment activities.
  • 2 years or more experience working with youth

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$52,000-62,000

We are vigilant, disciplined and always looking out for one another. Join Seadrill. Own the Opportunity.

title: Expert Network Project Coordinator
description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to continued growth, we are hiring for an Expert NetworkProject Coordinator at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Expert NetworkProject Coordinator assists the Client Service team with day-to-day management of market research studies, to ensure all projects successfully complete on time, within the budget and in accordance with the client specs, while meeting and exceeding client expectations.

This position is one of the key team members in the execution of the quantitative/qualitative projects, and is responsible for field management and sample strategies, and will be accountable for coordinating with respondents, vendors, and clients. They will assist with the set-up of the study and other project requirements as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and control sampling and fieldwork, including screener review for allocated projects.
  • Execute end to end project related tasks which could include (but not exclusively) link setup, link testing, languages requests, desk research, quality/audit checks, set up and delivery of study invitations, manage exclusion lists, M3 Wallet approvals, invoicing and cost reconciliation.
  • Address Support Team and other stakeholders’ requests in a timely manner.
  • Attend meetings with PMs regarding assigned projects to ensure project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities are understood.
  • Takes notes and fill checklists during key meetings and share them with the attendee afterwards
  • Host market research pretest/pilot interviews for clients, and ensure interviews are conducted on time and as planned. This will require direct client interactions.
  • Build, update and track customized fielding plans for all projects as needed.
  • Proactively seek alternative fieldwork strategies and find solutions to address response rates and costs on each project.
  • Manage and control of the partners on quantitative projects throughout the life cycle of the project, ensuring that M3 achieves and exceeds client’s expectations.
  • Track, monitor and report on sampling performance.
  • Support PMs with invoicing ensuring that projects are closed and ready for invoicing in a timely manner.
  • Alert the Project Manager of a project when a fieldwork strategy is failing or getting off track or there is a quality concern and work together to find alternative solutions.
  • Design and request multichannel recruitment methodologies for allocated projects, which could include (but not exclusively) email campaigns, calling, desk research, text messages, online advertisement, referral schemes, forums, blogs, patient groups and associations networking and social media.
  • Scheduling respondents for market research interviews, including creating the scheduler in the system, communication with respondents, coordinating shared moderator schedules, manual entry in MR system and moderator scheduling platforms.
  • Help respondents log in to qualitative platforms for their interviews and troubleshoot any issues.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
  • Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc
  • Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Fluent in English

Additional Information

title: Montevideo Development Graduate Programme
description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well-positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark-to-market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing and verify trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities

  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enables the physical movement commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities

  • Structuring and executing real-world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day-to-day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

  • Resiliência e Autonomia: Forte resiliência para lidar com rejeições e metas desafiadoras, combinada com a autonomia e autogestão necessárias para atuar longe da sede.
  • Senso Estratégico e Decisão: Perfil estratégico para priorizar ações e tomar decisões rápidas em campo que impactam diretamente o resultado do território.
  • Habilitação: CNH Categoria B regularizada e experiência em longas viagens.

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Descrição

Este(a) profissional atuará diretamente com ferramentas de segurança, colaborará com diferentes áreas técnicas e contribuirá para o fortalecimento da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS e outras soluções corporativas.

  • Analisar artefatos maliciosos, logs de rede, tráfego suspeito, comportamentos anômalos e possíveis violações.

  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, TTPs e ferramentas de ataque, sugerindo melhorias no ambiente.
  • Auxiliar na implementação e manutenção de ferramentas de segurança e projetos relacionados ao SOC.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prática em ambientes de SOC, com ferramentas como SIEM, EDR e IDS/IPS e Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e CIS.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação ou atuação em SOC/NOC.
  • Conhecimento sólido em análise de logs, tráfego de rede, protocolos (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS etc.) e investigação de incidentes.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como: SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, Elastic etc.), EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint etc.), IDS/IPS, WAF, DLP e soluções de Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e metodologias: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS Controls.
  • Conhecimento em redes, criptografia, proxies, firewalls e operações de segurança.
  • Boa comunicação para interação entre áreas e produção de relatórios técnicos/executivos.

Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

The successful candidate should be organized, highly responsive and diligent, able to apply strong attention to detail and accuracy. We are looking for someone who is able to work autonomously to deadlines and enjoys being a valued member of the team.

  • Input and update relevant data from the fixtures into internal systems, including contractual, financial documentation.

  • Check hire invoices, ensuring they are accurate and issued on time, and chase for payment if needed.

Accounts Receivable Duties

General Duties

  • Provide administrative assistance to our Offshore chartering team in general terms.

  • Relationship building –excellent communicator to effectively build strong, long-lasting relationships with colleagues, clients and others.
  • Collaboration – working well with others across diverse backgrounds to share information, develop skills and deliver results.
  • Resilience – persisting and adapting to changing or difficult situations, and adopting a positive and focused approach.
  • Smart – problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a curious and inquisitive mind, and an openness to new ideas.

Other requirements

  • Business, Economy or Accounting undergraduate students (preferable).

  • Highly responsive, and a strong communicator, both verbal and written.

title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM’s web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.
  • Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).
  • Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.
  • Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).
  • Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.
  • Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil)

  • Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.
  • Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).
  • Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
  • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.
  • Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting. HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

Resumes can be submitted to our Career Center by visiting our Katalyst Career Center.

description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO : A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver projeto e soluções de indústria 4.0 aplicadas aos Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) em escala de rede, elaborando layouts conceituais, diagramas unifilares e apoiando o detalhamento do projeto, desde a arquitetura de controle e proteção até a integração ao sistema de supervisão (SCADA).
  • Definir e validar arquiteturas de comunicação para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), assegurando a interoperabilidade entre os dispositivos e sua integração às plataformas de supervisão e controle. A implementação deve contemplar protocolos industriais consolidados (como Modbus RTU/TCP, CAN, IEC 61850) e soluções orientadas à Internet das Coisas (IoT), incluindo MQTT, bem como interfaces baseadas em serviços web (APIs RESTful), garantindo robustez, escalabilidade e conformidade com requisitos de cibersegurança.
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de rede de sistemas de supervisão em cloud computing AWS, considerando medidas de segurança da informação (VPN e firewall).
  • Estabelecer diretrizes, acompanhar e avaliar ensaios de rotina, testes de fábrica, testes de campo e comissionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia de Bateria (BESS) e de todos os equipamentos envolvidos, garantindo o correto funcionamento dentro dos padrões de operação e manutenção.
  • Realizar análise de tecnologias, produtos e fornecedores para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), visando suportar a adoção de soluções inovadoras e a definição de critérios técnicos para qualificação e seleção de possíveis parceiros.
  • Desenvolver relatórios técnicos escritos que transmitam conceitos de armazenamento de energia de bateria, casos de uso e resultados de estudos de viabilidade para o pipeline.
  • Realizar e validar dimensionamento de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), considerando suas funcionalidades e contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar e validar simulações em software de aplicações envolvendo Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Executar o desenvolvimento de planos de engenharia, especificações técnicas, estimativas de custo e documentos de construção de marcos de projeto para projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS).
  • Apoiar pipeline na identificação, definição e implementação de casos de uso para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS) em locais centralizados e/ou distribuídos.
  • Dar suporte técnico em todas as fases dos projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), como:
    • Planejamento e acompanhamento de projeto;
    • Elaboração de croquis e projetos preliminares, quando necessário;
    • Desenvolvimento de novos padrões tecnológicos com o objetivo de enriquecer as especificações técnicas;
    • Elaboração e atualização de Especificações Técnicas (ETs), Termo de Referencias e Projetos Básicos;
    • Desenvolvimento de equipamentos, sistemas e fornecedores;
    • Elaboração de Estudos Executivos;
    • Elaboração de parecer técnico sobre equipamentos e sistemas;
    • Testes de Aceite em Fábrica (TAF);
    • Comissionamento e Testes de Aceite em Campo (TAC).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Engenharia Eletrônica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Automação ou Engenharia Mecatrônica, com registro ativo no CREA.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de engenharia elétrica/energética, especialmente em sistemas de armazenamento de energia (BESS).
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento, especificação, implementação e comissionamento de projetos BESS.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica de pequenas equipes e coordenação de terceirizadas.
  • Capacidade de atuar dentro de equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar‑se de forma clara com partes interessadas internas e externas.

Requisitos Desejáveis

Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada.

Conheça o Modelo De Contrato Intermitente

  • A modalidade de contrato intermitente é regido pela CLT e a carteira de trabalho do empregado é assinada normalmente;
  • A prestação de serviços ocorre de forma não contínua, ou seja, o trabalhador é convocado para trabalhar quando há demanda do empregador e disponibilidade do empregado, sem uma jornada de trabalho fixa.
  • O empregado recebe apenas pelas horas efetivamente trabalhadas, sem salário fixo mensal.
  • Mesmo sendo intermitente, o trabalhador possui direitos como férias proporcionais, 13º salário, FGTS e INSS, proporcionais ao período trabalhado.

Um operador intermitente em um parque de turismo, desempenha atividades em diversas áreas, tem uma rotina dinâmica e variada. As principais atividades em cada um dos setores dos parques:

  • Conversão de vendas: Atuar com foco em metas, buscando transformar atendimentos em vendas efetivas, sempre prezando pela experiência positiva do cliente.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Assistant Professor
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
