title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the Investments Business Unit.

The Opportunity

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What We Have To Offer

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.
  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems: design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.
  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.
  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain: help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.
  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.
  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility: roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).
  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.
  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.
  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.
  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.
  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.
  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.
  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.
  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.
  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.
  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.
  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineerto join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

title: Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)
description:
Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)

Department: Safety & Security

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.

The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
  • Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
  • Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
  • Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
  • Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
  • Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
  • Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
  • Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
  • Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
  • Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
  • Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
  • Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
  • Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
  • Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
  • Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
  • Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
  • Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
  • Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
  • Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Especialista em Economia e Clima
description:
A Share People Hub, em parceria com o Instituto Clima e Sociedade (ICS), está buscando Especialista em Economia e Clima com atuação híbrida no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília.

Desafios da Posição

A Pessoa Especialista será responsável pela identificação e articulação de parceiros e donatários, acompanhamento técnico das iniciativas e leitura política qualificada, contribuindo para consolidar o ecossistema nacional de Economia e Clima.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar, sob a liderança da Gestão de Políticas Climáticas, na consolidação da agenda de Economia e Clima do iCS, garantindo coerência entre estratégia institucional, portfólio apoiado e metas relacionadas à incorporação da agenda climática nas decisões econômicas estruturantes do país.
  • Coordenar e qualificar a atuação do iCS na temática de mercado de carbono, acompanhando o processo regulatório, articulando parceiros estratégicos, promovendo alinhamentos técnicos entre mercado regulado e voluntário e apoiando a consolidação de um ecossistema institucional com governança robusta e previsibilidade regulatória.
  • Estruturar e gerir parcerias voltadas ao desenvolvimento e incidência em instrumentos econômicos, fiscais e tributários para a transição climática, incluindo precificação de carbono, mecanismos redistributivos e integração de critérios climáticos ao planejamento econômico.
  • Articular e fortalecer centros de pesquisa, think tanks e organizações estratégicas para ampliar a produção qualificada de análises econômicas sobre clima, assegurando alinhamento técnico, sinergia entre iniciativas apoiadas e foco em impacto regulatório e institucional.
  • Coordenar o acompanhamento técnico de estudos e projetos desenvolvidos por donatários e consultores, garantindo aderência às prioridades estratégicas do eixo, consistência metodológica e potencial de incidência nas políticas públicas.
  • Atuar na mobilização de financiamento verde, apoiando iniciativas que fortaleçam instrumentos financeiros públicos e privados, ampliem a alavancagem de capital para mitigação e adaptação e integrem critérios climáticos ao sistema financeiro e orçamentário.
  • Mapear e engajar atores governamentais, setor privado, sistema de justiça e sociedade civil para promover integração federativa e cooperação multissetorial na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Apoiar a definição de posicionamentos institucionais do iCS em debates estratégicos como reforma tributária, instrumentos financeiros públicos, planos de desenvolvimento e políticas econômicas com impacto climático.
  • Facilitar espaços técnicos de diálogo e articulação entre parceiros, promovendo convergência de agendas e construção de consensos qualificados.
  • Avaliar tecnicamente propostas de apoio, gerir o ciclo completo de projetos (aprovação, acompanhamento, monitoramento de resultados e reporte), assegurando alinhamento com os outcomes estratégicos do eixo.
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e notas estratégicas para a Diretoria e financiadores, sistematizando avanços, riscos e oportunidades na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com o cargo, conforme demandas estratégicas do eixo programático.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Ensino superior completo em Economia.
  • Mestrado, doutorado ou especialização relevante em Economia do Clima, Economia Ambiental, Políticas Públicas, Finanças Sustentáveis, Desenvolvimento Econômico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos em economia ambiental ou climática, políticas públicas econômicas ou financiamento sustentável.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos estratégicos, articulação multissetorial e acompanhamento técnico de estudos ou consultorias.
  • Experiência com: contexto do terceiro setor e filantropia, economia do clima, instrumentos econômicos e regulatórios para a transição climática, mercado de carbono, financiamento climático, análise de políticas públicas e gestão de portfólio de projetos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com processos regulatórios e políticas públicas será considerada diferencial.

O que esperamos de você | Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Responsividade, Dinamismo, agilidade, Atitude propositiva, Iniciativa, Trabalho EM e ENTRE equipes, Comprometimento, Criatividade, Atenção aos detalhes, Comunicação assertiva, Solução de problemas, Orientação para Resultados | Organização, Respeito e tolerância a diversidade

Modelo de Contratação

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

description:
What Success Looks Like In This Role

Provides consultation and hands‑on support to help leaders, teams, and organizations understand, adopt, and implement change initiatives. Supports the design and delivery of change, learning, and end‑user enablement activities that address resistance, improve adoption, and contribute to successful business outcomes. Focuses on the people side of change related to business process updates, systems and technology implementations, job role changes, and organizational adjustments, with an emphasis on end‑user readiness and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides change management, learning, and end‑user enablement support for defined initiatives and projects under the guidance of more senior practitioners.
  • Supports small to moderately complex change or enablement efforts, contributing to project workstreams as assigned.
  • Assists with change impact and readiness assessments to identify stakeholder needs, learning requirements, and end‑user impacts.
  • Helps identify process improvement opportunities by gathering input, documenting current‑state processes, and supporting future‑state recommendations.
  • Contributes to the identification of potential resistance, adoption risks, and capability gaps, and supports the development of mitigation strategies and enablement tactics.
  • Collaborates with change management team members, project teams, and stakeholders to develop and execute deliverables across:
    • Communications and messaging
    • Sponsorship and leadership support
    • Manager and team coaching materials
    • Learning and training content
    • End‑user enablement and support resources
    • Resistance and adoption management activities
  • Supports the design and delivery of learning assets (e.g., training sessions, job aids, guides, and performance support materials) that help end users adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Assists in facilitating training sessions, workshops, or enablement activities as needed.
  • Provides support to project teams and people leaders by reinforcing change and adoption practices.
  • Helps track adoption, learning effectiveness, and change progress metrics; documents issues, risks, and feedback.
  • Monitors end‑user feedback and adoption trends, escalating concerns and improvement opportunities to senior team members.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives related to technology, process, or business transformation.
  • Exposure to learning design, training delivery, or end‑user enablement activities.
  • Working knowledge of change management and continuous improvement concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create client‑ready deliverables and presentations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, stakeholders, and change colleagues globally.
  • Willingness to learn and grow change, learning, and enablement skills through personal development and hands‑on project experiences.

Additional Qualifications

  • Prosci Change Management Practitioner certification, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or related OCM certification is strongly preferred
  • Experience working across global, multi‑cultural environments is strongly preferred.
  • Multilingual communication skills are a plus
  • Prosci Train‑the‑Trainer Certification is a plus
  • PMP, Prince2, ITIL 4 or higher, Agile, Digital Transformation, Lean, Agile, Process Mapping and/or relevant instructional design and learning certifications are a plus

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization’s cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization’s digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICs, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICs).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICs.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high‑performance, employee‑centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high‑performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR‑related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Talent Acquisition, development & mobility
    • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
    • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
    • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
    • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high‑performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction and long‑term retention.
  • Performance management & organizational development
    • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management and leadership development strategies.
    • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
    • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data‑driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.

Responsabilidades Da Posição

O(a) Recepcionista será o primeiro ponto de contato dos pacientes e famílias na clínica, sendo responsável por proporcionar uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e humanizada desde o momento da chegada até o término do atendimento. Essa pessoa atuará em um ambiente com grande fluxo de pacientes e atendimentos por diversos planos de saúde, e terá papel essencial na organização do fluxo de agendamentos e documentação da clínica.

  • Receber e acolher pacientes e acompanhantes, oferecendo atendimento cordial e empático;
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados no sistema da clínica, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas;
  • Fazer agendamentos, remarcações e confirmações de consultas por telefone, WhatsApp e presencialmente;
  • Orientar sobre documentação, autorizações e guias necessárias para os atendimentos;
  • Conferir guias e autorizações de planos de saúde, encaminhando-as corretamente para o setor de faturamento;
  • Organizar e controlar a agenda dos profissionais, mantendo a comunicação clara entre pacientes e equipe técnica;
  • Apoiar na rotina administrativa da recepção, como controle de presença, emissão de recibos e arquivamento de documentos;
  • Manter o ambiente da recepção organizado e acolhedor, refletindo os valores de cuidado e profissionalismo da clínica.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Fisioterapia ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em recepção de clínica ou hospital, preferencialmente com atendimento a convênios de saúde;
  • Vivência com grande volume de atendimentos e rotina dinâmica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão clínica ou prontuário eletrônico;
  • Domínio básico do pacote Office (principalmente Excel e Outlook);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional e empática;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão no preenchimento e conferência de guias;
  • Comprometimento com sigilo e ética profissional, respeitando as informações dos pacientes e os protocolos internos.

Sobre a Empresa

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. Desde 1997, mantém uma sólida parceria com o Jockey Club Brasileiro e, atualmente, está presente em diversas unidades — entre elas, Lagoa, Sociedade Hípica Brasileira e Jacarepaguá. A clínica conta com uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, formada por profissionais de áreas como Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiologia, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Psicopedagogia e Equoterapia. Todos atuam de forma integrada, com foco em um atendimento humanizado, técnico e ético.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.

  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including: Regional Main , Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in person/online meetings, training events. Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded, and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs identify training needs, effectively reach targeted audiences, and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organizations, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet program quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.

Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature And Scope

Principal internal contacts generally include administrators, faculty, students and staff. External contacts generally include vendors, consultants, visitors and the general public.

Key Responsibilities

  • Control the workflow of the office. Implement office procedures and practices.
  • Perform directives from supervisor to coordinate administrative procedures within department and/or among other offices.

  • Check records, meet with staff and resolve any differences with accounting.
  • Supervise the scheduling of appointments, meetings and conferences for department heads and/or other department staff and students.
  • Coordinate logistics of all department events and meetings including travel and lodging arrangements, agendas, information packets, parking, amenities, etc. and provide on‑site guidance to visitors and guests for university related events.
  • Record and maintain agenda and minutes from all division, department and faculty meetings and distribute them accordingly.
  • Review catalogs and order office supplies and equipment. Obtain bids and price quotes from vendors, monitor inventory of supplies.
  • Create and manage office filing systems.
  • Receive, open and screen mail for the department.
  • Assist in the completion of grant proposals for the department and divisions within the department.
  • Process paperwork for the hiring of new salaried personnel, and advise them concerning the University’s procedures.
  • Enter personnel and financial documents with related software applications.
  • Perform data analysis of average difficulty using tables, graphs and basic statistics. Submit final reports to department administrators and/or managers.
  • Perform other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access). Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population. Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business field – Accounting, Finance, Computer information Systems, Cyber Security, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, Management, Economics and 3-6 years of experience.

$45,000-$55,000

REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência.

O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência.

Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

PROCESSO SELETIVO

1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:

1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.

1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato; caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.

1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso.

1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.

1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.

1.7.6 O Processo Seletivo será composto de:

  • 1ª ETAPA – Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 2ª ETAPA – Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 3ª ETAPA – Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
  • 4ª ETAPA – Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.

Somente o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado terá direito à contratação.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO

  • Atuar em centro cirúrgico ou CME ou enfermaria cirúrgica pediátrica;
  • Auxiliar a equipe em procedimentos invasivos;
  • Auxiliar em reanimação de paciente;
  • Aprontar paciente para exame e cirurgia;
  • Coletar material para exames;
  • Controlar administração de medicamentos;
  • Auxiliar a equipe cirúrgica durante o ato operatório;
  • Responsável pela organização da sala operatória;
  • Acompanhamento e vigilância de pacientes em SRPA;
  • Realizar a recepção de instrumental cirúrgico em área de limpeza de CME, realizar lavagem de instrumental e preparar pacotes de esterilização de instrumental e organizar o material na área de guarda e dispensação do material para o centro cirúrgico;
  • Realizar acolhimento de pacientes e familiares e verificação de sinais em atendimento ambulatorial;
  • E demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.

A Eneva é uma empresa séria e comprometida com a transparência em seus processos seletivos e não solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento durante o processo de seleção.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM ESF - AP 1.0
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desempenhar as atividades técnicas de enfermagem, prestando assistências ao paciente de forma a zelar pelo seu conforto e bem estar, realizando registros e relatórios técnicos, bem como organizando o ambiente de trabalho em conformidade às boas práticas, normas e procedimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio e Curso Técnico de Enfermagem Completos;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho de Classe;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 6 (seis) meses, na função proposta.

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: AP 1.0 (Região Central do Rio e Paquetá)

Horário de trabalho: 40h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Senior Technical Consultant- RJ

The Senior Technical Consultant is ultimately responsible for leading large, complex, customer engagements, and ensuring the technical success of the Global Delivery Services. With a requirement for the combination of coaching junior consultants, leading solution designs, troubleshooting, escalation management, and hands‑on delivery. The Senior TC will also work closely with the project manager to ensure project status is communicated, a plan is in place, and progress is being made to achieve project completion. The role will apply advanced subject matter expertise to complex business issues; working on multifaceted problems/projects where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Within our delivery centers, the role expects a high degree of technical aptitude and attention to detail at all times. They are expected to perform independently and carry out Storage, Compute, Data Protection, and other technical activities autonomously. They have a strong understanding of the overall IT Infrastructure components, especially Storage, Compute & Data Protection technologies and have a deep knowledge of ITIL processes & services and can put them into practice as & where needed. They drive customer projects and can provide resolutions to escalated issues & problems. They are expected to mentor the junior staff and write detailed process documents, work‑instructions, and run‑books.

What you will bring

  • Perform & lead innovative Delivery Services for Hitachi Vantara customers as defined in a Statement of Work
  • Create detailed technical designs from high level solution designs, based on an analysis of the customer's environment and requirements
  • Take strategic decisions in consultation with Service Delivery Manager (SDM) / Project Manager (PM) based on the most relevant factors available that drive effectiveness and value to the customer
  • Provide technical subject expertise to troubleshoot and identify operational, connectivity and network issues, providing rational business cases and arguments to persuade upwardly and with peers
  • Assist with the creation of new innovative delivery collateral and maintenance of existing delivery collateral. Recommending improvements in order to increase efficiency, effectiveness and pioneering customer success
  • Provide analysis and implementation support for SAN/NAS Storage solutions, initial implementation, and integration into the environment as required
  • Provide input into the creation, establishment and maintenance of IT policies, procedures and practices using ITIL framework to efficiently manage the storage infrastructure
  • Provide input to the Service Delivery Manager for the monthly governance meetings and reports with the customer and Hitachi.
  • Coach and train technical consultants, whilst also providing guidance to local teams or 3rd party partners, building mutual support, and understanding with colleagues
  • Supports the SDM & PM in strengthening the relationship with the customer
  • Identify and provide suggested continuous improvement initiatives within the account

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5+ years technical consultancy and enterprise experience
  • 7+ years technical IT related experience
  • At least five years' experience within Hitachi technologies, a similar competitor organization, end user or IT consultancy services provider
  • A demonstrated problem solver, mentor, coach, and leader who can work independently, is well organized, and always pays close attention to detail
  • A willingness to work a flexible schedule and to travel is a must for this role
  • Demonstrate strong presentation skills on technical subjects
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers at all levels

About us

Championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are integral to our culture and identity. Diverse thinking, a commitment to allyship, and a culture of empowerment help us achieve powerful results. We want you to be you, with all the ideas, lived experience, and fresh perspective that brings. We support your uniqueness and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our team.

How we look after you

We want to help you take care of your today and tomorrow - at home and at work. Which is why we offer industry‑leading benefits that go far beyond compensation. That means support, services, and resources that also take care of your holistic health and wellbeing. We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. Here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent).

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. title: VP, Legal – Corporate and M&A
description:
Who Are We

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit

Who Are You

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

The Role

Live Nation’s Latin America Concerts business is seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President, Legal – Corporate & M&A to serve as the senior legal leader responsible for all corporate, regulatory, and transactional legal matters for Live Nation Brazil Holdings. This executive provides strategic legal counsel on corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and shareholder matters, ensuring alignment with both Brazilian legal requirements and the parent company’s global governance standards.

What This Role Will Do

  • Oversee all corporate, regulatory, and transactional legal activities for the organization in Brazil.
  • Provide strategic guidance to senior leadership on corporate governance, M&A transactions, joint ventures, and shareholder agreements.
  • Lead and manage due diligence processes, transaction structuring, and contract negotiation in connection with acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships.
  • Collaborate closely with the parent company’s global legal and compliance teams to ensure consistency with global policies, standards, and risk management practices.
  • Ensure the company’s corporate structure, regulatory filings, and operational activities remain fully compliant with Brazilian laws and regulations.
  • Manage and coordinate external counsel as needed to support corporate and transactional matters.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and advise leadership on potential legal and compliance risks.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (LL.B. or equivalent law degree) and admission to practice law in Brazil.
  • Extensive experience in corporate law, mergers and acquisitions, and regulatory compliance within Brazil.
  • Demonstrated experience advising senior executives on complex corporate and transactional matters.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global legal teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills and experience managing outside counsel.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to make clear concise decisions, sometimes with limited information.
  • Strong, proactive work ethic and ability to work both independently and as a team player in a fast-paced environment.
  • Extreme attention to detail and advanced organizational skills.
  • Positive attitude, commitment to excellence and teamwork; able to work seamlessly with heads of functional areas across the company and around the world.

Benefits / Compensation

Compensation and benefits for this role will be determined based on the employee’s location and aligned with local market practices and Brazilian labor regulations. Details will be provided during the offer process. This role may be eligible for bonus subject to plan terms and local eligibility.

Hiring Practices

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long‑term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

Check us out here:

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a hungry, junior security professional whose default instinct is to attack first, patch second. This isn’t a governance-and-policy desk job. You’ll spend your days trying to break into our own systems, finding the cracks before anyone else does, and then relentlessly closing them.

If your idea of a good day is discovering a misconfigured S3 bucket, popping a shell on a test environment, and writing up the fix before lunch read on.

Break things (on purpose)

  • Continuously run penetration tests against our web apps, APIs, internal tools, and cloud infrastructure
  • Conduct phishing simulations and social engineering tests against our own team
  • Perform recon, enumeration, and exploitation attempts on our systems in a controlled, authorized way
  • Hunt for vulnerabilities before real attackers do - then document and upscale them

Harden everything you find

  • Work directly with engineering to remediate vulnerabilities you uncover
  • Tighten cloud security configurations (AWS) - IAM policies, exposed services, secrets management
  • Review access controls and flag over‑privileged accounts, then drive least‑privilege fixes
  • Implement and tune monitoring tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS) so we catch anything that slips through

Keep the lights on

  • Assist with incident detection and response when real events occur
  • Help maintain audit logs and ensure we have visibility across our systems
  • Support compliance work (GDPR, SOC 2) as it relates to technical controls

Requirements

Must-have

  • 1–2 years of experience in security, pentesting, bug bounty, or a related hands‑on role (or equivalent self‑taught experience with proof)
  • Demonstrable ability to find and exploit common vulnerabilities - OWASP Top 10, misconfigurations, broken access controls
  • Basic cloud security knowledge (AWS preferred) - you know what “public S3 bucket” means and why it’s bad
  • Comfortable using tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, or similar
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and how to think like a threat actor
  • You document your findings clearly – written reports matter as much as the exploit

Nice-to-have

  • CTF experience or an active HackTheBox / TryHackMe profile
  • Any security certifications: eJPT, CEH, Security+, OSCP (in progress counts)
  • Scripting ability in Python or Bash to automate recon or testing
  • Interest or background in DeFi, crypto, or Web3 security
  • Familiarity with smart contract attack vectors (a big bonus)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Fully remote – work from anywhere
  • Unlimited PTO and flexible schedule
  • Team off‑sites and events
  • A genuine mandate to break our stuff and make us stronger for it

Ready to hack with purpose?

If you’ve been sharpening your skills on bug bounties, CTFs, or homelab environments and want your first real shot at doing this professionally – we want to hear from you. Show us what you’ve found, what you’ve broken, and how you fixed it.

  • Inovação no Segmento: A Seara está sempre inovando, desenvolvendo produtos que atendem às necessidades dos consumidores modernos, como opções saudáveis, práticas e deliciosas, incluindo a linha Seara Gourmet e Seara Nature.
  • Práticas Sustentáveis: A Seara adota práticas sustentáveis em toda a sua cadeia produtiva, priorizando o bem-estar animal, a eficiência energética e a gestão responsável de recursos.

  • Responsável pela segurança de sua equipe, e das máquinas e equipamentos de sua área, através da observação, cumprimento e difusão das normas e procedimentos de segurança no trabalho;

description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands-on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys-related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Compliance Counsel under the guidance of the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 and the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department will provide compliance support and oversight in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and help to ensure that FWWC 2027’s activities comply with applicable compliance laws and regulations and meet best practices.

The FWWC 2027 is seeking an experienced individual to be an integral part of the FWWC 2027 team, responsible for implementing and overseeing a comprehensive governance and compliance programme throughout the organisation.

This person will act as a point of reference in Brazil for compliance‑related matters within FWWC 2027, as well as be the compliance liaison for the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department in Miami.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance

  • Establish a framework to identify, prioritize and enable the effective and efficient management of compliance risks facing the organisation through periodic compliance risk assessment.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Compliance and Risk team in Miami to design, implement and periodically review compliance policies and procedures governing key risk areas such conflicts of interest, anti‑bribery and corruption, anti‑money laundering/KYC, gifts and entertainment, etc.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the compliance programme activities.
  • Provide ad hoc compliance and governance related advice.
  • Design and work with HR and Internal Communications to develop and deliver a compliance awareness and training programme.
  • Liaise with external counsel on compliance matters.
  • If applicable, liaise with regulators and auditors.
  • Perform investigations and advise on whistleblower and hotline case management.
  • Advise on third‑party risk and management, including implementing and overseeing third‑party due diligence processes.
  • Manage conflicts of interest, including any required disclosures associated with such conflicts of interest.
  • Key point of reference for the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 on all compliance matters in Brazil.
  • Act as main compliance delegate for overall FWWC 2027 risk management activities, including timely implementation of compliance risk mitigation plans.

General

  • Demonstrate a team‑based approach to achieving the best outcomes for FWWC 2027 in accordance with FIFA’s values.
  • Ensure productive working relationships with all the relevant stakeholders (FIFA, CBF, Host Cities, stadium authorities, government entities, FIFA’s Commercial Affiliates, multilateral development institutions, NGOs and local communities).
  • Demonstrate an understanding of FWWC 2027’s commercial drivers and desired outcomes, and a willingness to take a hands‑on approach.
  • Manage the escalation process for compliance risks.
  • Drive process efficiency and policy improvement.
  • Ensure the assigned responsibilities are delivered: to a high standard of quality and timeliness; in full compliance with the safety and security rules and requirements of FWWC 2027 and FIFA; and in line with any applicable key performance indicators.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil (or the ability to easily obtain this qualification)

Experience

  • A minimum of 4 - 5 years’ experience as a qualified lawyer, with in‑house experience preferred

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help scale and evolve a clinician-facing internal platform that directly supports the daily work of thousands of healthcare professionals. This platform is mission‑critical to care delivery operations, powering scheduling workflows, clinician experience, operational processes, data insights, and adherence to quality standards.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy and hands‑on execution . You will own a defined product area, drive delivery against the roadmap, and lead discovery for initiatives that improve clinician workflows, care quality, and operational efficiency. While the platform is primarily used internally, its impact is highly visible and measurable, directly influencing patient outcomes, clinician satisfaction, and business performance.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and clinical stakeholders to translate real‑world operational needs into scalable, reliable product solutions. This role is ideal for a Product Manager who thrives in workflow‑heavy environments , enjoys tackling complex systems, and is motivated by building tools that make a meaningful difference in how care is delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver product initiatives that improve clinician workflows and care delivery performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinical and operational stakeholders to ensure solutions fit real‑world needs.
  • Lead discovery efforts: identify pain points, validate solutions, and define measurable success metrics.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to prioritize and execute against the product roadmap.
  • Support day‑to‑day execution with engineering teams (standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, QA, launch readiness).
  • Define success metrics and align teams on measurable outcomes for product initiatives.
  • Ensure high product quality through strong product hygiene (acceptance criteria, edge cases, release management, post‑launch monitoring).
  • Use data to guide decisions, measure impact, and iterate after launch.
  • Help establish repeatable processes for balancing roadmap work with bug fixes and support requests.

Must Have

  • 4+ years of experience in Product Management , owning product delivery and outcomes.
  • Experience building workflow‑heavy products (internal tools, platforms, enterprise or operational systems).
